crossRefs.note: The king said, “Let him return to his own house, but let him not see my face.” So Absalom returned to his own house…

people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Absalom lived two full years in Jerusalem, and he didn’t see the king’s face.
translations.bsb: Now Absalom lived in Jerusalem two years without seeing the face of the king.
translations.kjv: So Absalom dwelt two full years in Jerusalem, and saw not the king's face.
translations.asv: And Absalom dwelt two full years in Jerusalem; and he saw not the king's face.
